label: Dr. Eggman
description: Bombastic, gloating and theatrical: a genius with an IQ of three hundred and a grudge against a hedgehog.
direction: Speak big, bombastic and theatrical, a gloating mad scientist with a booming laugh in his voice: pompous, gleeful, quick to bluster when thwarted. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. The game-era Eggman: pompous glee, then bluster. Speeding is left to the hedgehog. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.author: Sega (character designed by Naoto Ohshima)
rights.pd_basis: None. Sega holds copyright and trademark in the character, also known as Dr. Robotnik. Mike Pollock has voiced him in the games since 2005 and Jim Carrey plays him on film; both are living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Mike Pollock's and Jim Carrey's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Ho ho ho! Exactly on schedule.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Genius takes time.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Get a load of this!
lines.start_drive_1: Ho ho ho! The Eggman Empire is on the move. Drive!
lines.start_drive_2: Get a load of this! A flawless route, designed by a genius.
lines.start_drive_3: I am the great Doctor Eggman, and I will be your navigator.
lines.start_drive_4: Engines on! My brilliant plan begins now.
lines.start_drive_5: With an IQ of three hundred, I think I can find the way.
lines.start_drive_6: No blue hedgehog can stop this journey. Onward!
lines.start_drive_7: Behold, my latest invention! It's a route. Admire it.
lines.start_drive_8: Seat belts on, minions. Eggman Land awaits!
lines.start_drive_9: Today, the world will bow to my genius. After a short drive.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. A minor setback! I meant to do that.
lines.arrived: We have arrived! Ho ho ho! Another triumph for Doctor Eggman.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Ho ho ho!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. I hate that hedgehog.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Curses! I should have built a flying machine.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Not one of my machines, I promise.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Careful! If that's a hedgehog, I'm leaving.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down! Speeding is for hedgehogs.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! Even an evil genius waits.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Hide the doomsday plans and slow down.
lines.reroute_chime: No! Missed it! No matter. I always have another scheme.
